info.title: Datadog
info.description: Datadog is a cloud-scale monitoring and security platform. This connector enables you to manage monitors, incidents, events, SLOs, and downtimes, and react to infrastructure alerts in your automation flows.

get.description: Retrieves a list of all monitors in your Datadog organization, with optional filtering by name, tags, or state.

parameters.name: group_states
parameters.description: Comma-separated list of group states to filter on (e.g., alert,warn,no data).

parameters.name: name
parameters.description: Filter monitors by name (substring match).

parameters.name: tags
parameters.description: Comma-separated list of tags to filter monitors (e.g., env:production,team:infra).

parameters.name: monitor_tags
parameters.description: Comma-separated list of monitor tags to filter on.

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: Page number for pagination (0-indexed).

parameters.name: page_size
parameters.description: Number of monitors per page (default 100).

get.description: Retrieves the details of a specific monitor by its ID.

parameters.name: monitor_id
parameters.description: The ID of the monitor to retrieve.

parameters.name: group_states
parameters.description: Comma-separated group states to include in the response.

post.description: Mutes a monitor to suppress alert notifications, optionally scoped to a specific group and with an expiration time.

parameters.name: monitor_id
parameters.description: The ID of the monitor to mute.

scope.description: Scope to apply the mute to (e.g., host:my-server). If omitted, mutes all scopes.

end.description: POSIX timestamp for when the mute should expire. If omitted, mutes indefinitely.

post.description: Unmutes a previously muted monitor to resume alert notifications.

parameters.name: monitor_id
parameters.description: The ID of the monitor to unmute.

all_scopes.description: If true, unmutes all scopes. Default is false.

get.description: Retrieves a list of incidents from your Datadog organization, sorted by creation date.

parameters.name: page[size]
parameters.description: Number of incidents per page (default 10, max 100).

parameters.name: page[offset]
parameters.description: Offset for pagination.

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description: Sort incidents by public_id. Use -public_id for descending (newest first) or public_id for ascending.

post.description: Declares a new incident in Datadog with a title, severity, and incident commander.

title.description: Human-readable incident title (e.g., Production API latency spike).

customer_impacted.description: Whether customers are impacted by this incident.

value.description: Severity level: SEV-1, SEV-2, SEV-3, SEV-4, or SEV-5.

id.description: UUID of the incident commander (Datadog user ID).

get.description: Retrieves the full details of a specific incident by its ID.

parameters.name: incident_id
parameters.description: The UUID of the incident to retrieve.

parameters.name: include
parameters.description: Comma-separated list of related resources to include (e.g., users, attachments).

patch.description: Updates an existing incident's title, severity, state, or customer impact status.

parameters.name: incident_id
parameters.description: The UUID of the incident to update.

id.description: Must match the incident_id path parameter.

value.description: Updated severity: SEV-1, SEV-2, SEV-3, SEV-4, or SEV-5.
Updated state: active, stable, resolved, or completed.

post.description: Posts a custom event to the Datadog event stream, useful for tracking deployments, releases, or external system changes.

title.description: Event title (e.g., Deployment completed â€” v2.1.0).

priority.description: Priority: normal or low. Default is normal.

alert_type.description: Alert type: info, warning, error, or success. Default is info.

host.description: Host name to associate the event with.

date_happened.description: POSIX timestamp of when the event occurred. Defaults to now.

get.description: Returns the total number of active and up hosts in your Datadog organization.

parameters.name: from
parameters.description: POSIX timestamp. Only count hosts that have reported since this time.

get.description: Retrieves a list of all Service Level Objectives (SLOs) in your Datadog organization.

parameters.name: query
parameters.description: Filter SLOs by name (substring match).

parameters.name: tags_query
parameters.description: Filter SLOs by tags (e.g., env:production).

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Maximum number of SLOs to return (default 1000).

parameters.name: offset
parameters.description: Offset for pagination.

post.description: Schedules a downtime to suppress alert notifications for specific monitors or scopes during planned maintenance.

scope.description: Scope the downtime applies to (e.g., env:production, host:my-server, or * for all).

message.description: Message to include with the downtime notification.

start.description: ISO 8601 start time. Defaults to now.

end.description: ISO 8601 end time. If omitted, downtime is indefinite until cancelled.

monitor_id.description: ID of a specific monitor to mute. If omitted, applies to all monitors matching the scope.

mute_first_recovery_notification.description: If true, mutes the first recovery notification after the downtime ends. Default is false.

get.description: Triggers when a Datadog monitor enters Alert or Warn state. Polls periodically for monitors in alert states.
get.x-ms-trigger-hint: Triggers when a Datadog monitor enters Alert or Warn state.

parameters.name: tags
parameters.description: Comma-separated tags to filter monitors (e.g., env:production).

200.description: A list of monitors in alert state.

get.summary: When a new incident is created
get.description: Triggers when a new incident is declared in Datadog. Polls periodically for recently created incidents.
get.x-ms-trigger-hint: Triggers when a new incident is declared in Datadog.

200.description: A list of recently created incidents.

type.description: Monitor type (e.g., metric alert, service check, event alert).

overall_state.description: Current state: OK, Alert, Warn, No Data, or Unknown.

name.description: Name of the user who created the monitor.

overall_state.description: Current state: OK, Alert, Warn, No Data, or Unknown.

name.description: Name of the user who created the monitor.

severity.description: Severity level: SEV-1 through SEV-5, or UNKNOWN.

state.description: Incident state (e.g., active, stable, resolved, completed).

url.description: URL to view the event in Datadog.

status.description: Status of the request (ok on success).

total_active.description: Total number of active hosts (reporting within the last 2 hours).

total_up.description: Total number of hosts currently up.

type.description: SLO type: metric, monitor, or time_slice.

status.description: Downtime status (scheduled, active, ended, or cancelled).
